	public static DungeonGenerationStyleData GetStyleForTile(List<DungeonGenerationStyleData> styles, int tileType)
	{
		foreach (DungeonGenerationStyleData style in styles)
		{
			if (style.TileIsInStyle(tileType))
			{
				return style;
			}
			if (style.SubStyles == null || style.SubStyles.Count <= 0)
			{
				continue;
			}
			foreach (DungeonGenerationStyleData subStyle in style.SubStyles)
			{
				if (subStyle.TileIsInStyle(tileType))
				{
					return subStyle;
				}
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	public static DungeonGenerationStyleData GetStyleForWall(List<DungeonGenerationStyleData> styles, int wallType)
	{
		foreach (DungeonGenerationStyleData style in styles)
		{
			if (style.WallIsInStyle(wallType))
			{
				return style;
			}
			if (style.SubStyles == null || style.SubStyles.Count <= 0)
			{
				continue;
			}
			foreach (DungeonGenerationStyleData subStyle in style.SubStyles)
			{
				if (subStyle.WallIsInStyle(wallType))
				{
					return subStyle;
				}
			}
		}
		return null;
	}
}

# UnifiedRandom (.NET Random 语义) —— /tmp/dgsrc/UnifiedRandom.cs 1:1
class UR:
    def __init__(self, seed: int):
        sa = [0] * 56
        num = abs(seed) if seed != -2**31 else 2**31 - 1
        num2 = 161803398 - num
        sa[55] = num2
        num3 = 1
        for j in range(1, 55):
            num4 = 21 * j % 55
            sa[num4] = num3
            num3 = num2 - num3
            if num3 < 0:
                num3 += 2147483647
            num2 = sa[num4]
        for _k in range(1, 5):
            for l in range(1, 56):
                sa[l] -= sa[1 + (l + 30) % 55]
                if sa[l] < 0:
                    sa[l] += 2147483647
        self.sa = sa
        self.inext = 0

    def internal_sample(self) -> int:
        num = self.inext + 1
        if num > 55:
            num = 1
        num2 = num + 21
        if num2 > 55:
            num2 -= 55
        num3 = self.sa[num] - self.sa[num2]
        if num3 == 2147483647:
            num3 -= 1
        num3 = num3 + ((num3 >> 31) & 0x7FFFFFFF)
        self.sa[num] = num3
        self.inext = num
        return num3

    def sample(self) -> float:
        return self.internal_sample() * 4.656612875245797e-10

    def next(self, mn=None, mx=None):
        if mn is None:
            return self.internal_sample()
        if mx is None:
            return int(self.sample() * mn)
        return int(self.sample() * (mx - mn)) + mn


def samples_at(seed: int, k0: int, n: int):
    """返回从第 k0 掷开始的连续 n 个 raw internal_sample 值（0-based 掷序）。"""
    u = UR(seed)
    for _ in range(k0):
        u.internal_sample()
    return [u.internal_sample() for _ in range(n)]

    for (int j = y - hgt + 1; j <= y; j++)

}

}
